---
title: "SSR 2026-2027"
author: "Johnny van Doorn"
date: today
---

The handouts are 1 continuous page, while the slides are spread across multiple pages (navigate with the arrow keys). To get a pdf, I recommend you use the print option in your browser to print the handout to pdf (open the handout and press `ctrl + p` (Windows) or `cmd + p` (MacOS)). 

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# One knob per academic year: bump this and everything below follows.
year_dir    <- "2026"
course.path <- paste0("ssr/", year_dir, "/")

# Resolve the lecture folder whether this file is knit standalone (wd is already
# ssr/<year>) or as a child of overview-ssr.qmd (wd is ssr/). Keep it relative:
# an absolute path breaks the GitHub Actions render.
if (basename(getwd()) != year_dir) setwd(year_dir)

files <- list.files(full.names = F, pattern = "\\.qmd$", recursive = T)

files <- files[grep("ssr.qmd", files, invert = TRUE)]
files <- files[!grepl(files, pattern = "MiscFiles")]

# Only the lecture files themselves are numbered (e.g. "11. t_test.qmd"); the
# sub-topic qmds inside a lecture folder are not, so drop everything unnumbered.
files <- files[grepl("^[0-9]+\\.", basename(files))]

lectures = data.frame()
n = length(files)

files <- files[order(as.numeric(sub("^([0-9]+)\\..*$", "\\1", basename(files))))]


for (i in 1:n) {

  lectures[i ,'url'] <- data.frame(url = paste0(course.path, files[i]))
  yaml <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(files[i])
  
  lectures[i , 'title'] = yaml$title
  lectures[i , 'date'] = yaml$date
  lectures[i , 'file_name'] = files[i]

}

handoutLinks <- sprintf('<a href="https://JohnnyDoorn.github.io/teaching-statistics/%s" target="_blank" class="external">link</a>', gsub("qmd", "html", lectures$url))
slideLinks <- sprintf('<a href="https://JohnnyDoorn.github.io/teaching-statistics/%s" target="_blank" class="external">link</a>', gsub("qmd", "slide.html", lectures$url))

# handoutLinks[grepl(lectures$date, pattern = "2025")] <- slideLinks[grepl(lectures$date, pattern = "2025")] <- "-"

data.frame(Date    = lectures$date, 
           Lecture = lectures$title,
           Handout = handoutLinks,
           Slides  = slideLinks
          ) -> lecture.list

# Only list a lecture once its date has actually been set for this year; a date
# still marked "TODO" means the lecture is not ready to be shown yet.
ready <- grepl(year_dir, lectures$date) & !grepl("TODO", lectures$date, ignore.case = TRUE)
lecture.list <- lecture.list[ready, ]
# Sort on date
library("lubridate")
library("dplyr")
# Extract the numeric part from the "Lecture" column
lecture.list$LectureNumber <- as.numeric(sub("^([0-9]+).*", "\\1", lecture.list$Lecture))

# Sort the data frame by the extracted lecture number
lecture.list <- lecture.list[order(lecture.list$LectureNumber), ]
# lecture.list$Date <- lubridate::dmy(lecture.list$Date)
# lubridate::mdy(lecture.list$Date)
lecture.list <- lecture.list[, -(ncol(lecture.list))]
library('kableExtra')

# Print table with kable as set in YAML
if (nrow(lecture.list) == 0) {
  knitr::asis_output('<p class="text-muted fst-italic">Lectures will appear here as the semester progresses.</p>')
} else {
  knitr::kable(dplyr::arrange(lecture.list), escape = FALSE, format = "html" ) %>%
    kable_styling(full_width = TRUE)
}
```
